protocol.rule: live state.assemble; fundamental composite PIT (TickerData.observe), technical (features.compute), regime (RegimeFeatureProvider) as of the decision session; news missing
protocol.decision_sessions: last XNYS session of each calendar month
protocol.window: entry at the next session close, exit 20 sessions later (adjusted closes)
protocol.reward: risk-scaled-residual-paper-reward.v5: (direction x (stock return - beta x SPY return) - 20 bps) / ex-ante volatility over the window; FLAT = 0
protocol.beta: beta_63_vs_spy at the decision session, clipped to [0.0, 3.0], default 1.0
protocol.unit: calendar month of the decision: mean across stocks with a decision that month
protocol.interval: Newey-West lag-1 standard error of the monthly means, Student t(n-1) 97.5% quantile

hypotheses.H1: heuristic beats abstention: mean monthly reward > 0 and its lower 95% bound > 0
hypotheses.H2: heuristic beats the momentum baseline (technical component alone, same +/-0.25 threshold): mean paired monthly difference > 0 and lower bound > 0
hypotheses.H3: the fundamental component adds value: heuristic minus heuristic without the fundamental signal, mean paired monthly difference > 0 and lower bound > 0

protocol.use: baseline for the forward direction test; never changes trading, the live protocol or promotion
caveats: Universe is today's coverage list: survivorship-biased.
Fundamental scoring thresholds were hand-set in 2026 with knowledge of these histories.
No historical headlines: the news component is missing throughout.
The replay composite has no earnings-surprise (expectations) input.
Short positions carry no borrow cost; fills are at closes with fixed costs.
